claim: My domestic flight was delayed by 7 hours. What are my options?
expected_outcome: Alternate flight or refund options

claim: My flight has a block time of 2 hours. I checked in on time and departure is delayed by 3 hours.
expected_outcome: Meals and refreshments subject to applicable conditions

claim: My flight was scheduled to depart at 10 PM but has been delayed by 8 hours.
expected_outcome: Hotel accommodation and transfer facilities subject to applicable conditions

claim: My flight was delayed by an hour. It has a block time of 2 hours and I checked in on time.
expected_outcome: Specified meal threshold not reached

claim: My flight was cancelled and I was informed three weeks before departure.
expected_outcome: Alternate flight or refund as acceptable to passenger

claim: My flight was cancelled. I was told 90 minutes before departure, was already at the airport, and accepted an alternative flight four hours later.
expected_outcome: No cancellation compensation under the assignment scenario; meals and refreshments while waiting

claim: My flight was cancelled at the last minute. I declined the alternative flight and requested a full refund. The flight block time was 90 minutes.
expected_outcome: Assess compensation and refund subject to notice and exception conditions

claim: My flight was cancelled unexpectedly, but I never provided a phone number or email during booking.
expected_outcome: Financial compensation exclusion; refund or alternate arrangements still considered

claim: I was denied boarding due to overbooking, but the airline arranged a replacement flight departing 45 minutes later.
expected_outcome: No denied-boarding compensation under the one-hour provision

claim: I was denied boarding involuntarily due to overbooking. My replacement flight departs 10 hours later.
expected_outcome: Evaluate compensation under the within-24-hours provision

claim: I had a confirmed ticket but was denied boarding because I arrived at the gate after boarding closed.
expected_outcome: Check boarding compliance and whether denial qualifies under the regulation

claim: The airline overbooked my flight and denied me boarding. I did not accept any alternative flight.
expected_outcome: Evaluate full refund and applicable denied-boarding compensation

claim: I booked business class for a domestic flight but was involuntarily moved to economy.
expected_outcome: Assess domestic involuntary downgrade reimbursement

claim: I was involuntarily downgraded on an international flight of 1200 km.
expected_outcome: Assess international downgrade reimbursement for distance up to 1500 km

claim: I voluntarily accepted an economy seat instead of my booked business-class seat.
expected_outcome: Involuntary downgrade provision may not apply

claim: My flight was delayed because of severe weather. The airline says it was beyond their control, but I dispute this.
expected_outcome: Cause attribution disputed

claim: My flight was cancelled because of an air traffic control restriction that the airline says could not be avoided.
expected_outcome: Assess extraordinary-circumstances exemption with supporting evidence

claim: My flight was cancelled. I want compensation, but I do not know when I received the cancellation notice.
expected_outcome: Cancellation notice timing required

claim: I want compensation for a domestic train journey delayed by five hours.
expected_outcome: Claim is outside the aviation corpus

claim: My airline cancelled my flight and I am requesting compensation, but I cannot provide the flight details, booking record, or cancellation notice.
expected_outcome: Request evidence before determining entitlement
